policy: Learning determines candidate changes; it is not part of the default regression. Estimated time budgets are scheduling guidance, never a reason to turn unfinished work into PASS.

collections.trigger: Schimbarea bugetelor sau mecanismelor de căutare AI; calificare JVM explicită
collections.evidence: Poziții legale generate la 2–8 cărți, profil copiat înainte de execuție, cost CPU și lucru măsurat, mediu identificat. Fără corpus, emulator sau verdict de progres strategic.

collections.trigger: Focused offline checks of contextual honor exits, quota, public-card distinctions and legal reachability witnesses
collections.evidence: Verificări contextuale cu martori legali independenți și capturi complete ale cazurilor; fără turnee sau acțiuni Android.
Native JUnit XML; documentation receipts when explicitly requested
collections.promotion: Counterexample must have an independent expectation, stable case ID, and named rule.

collections.trigger: Before promoting a policy or APK
collections.evidence: Full offline JUnit regression. No learning tournaments and no emulator.

collections.trigger: Before a strategy experiment; small safety/cover/auction cases and accepted-baseline snapshot parity
collections.evidence: Actual component assertions; profile controls are not optimal-action labels.

collections.trigger: Schimbări ale regulilor, punctajului sau ajutorului
collections.evidence: Raport Extent al colecției, confruntat cu JUnit, cu probe factuale și exemple de reguli în RO/EN.

collections.task: Protocol-dependent: run-whist-collection.ps1 dispatches the declared supported schema
collections.evidence: The explicit protocol selects its frozen baselines and tournament task. Supported schemas are7/11/12/15/16/18; schema18 uses ExpertV17 and IndependentV11. Every JSON game and original outcome is retained externally. Development screening and untouched fresh evaluation remain separate.
requires: Frozen protocol; untouched heldout before promotion
Explicit protocol JSON; new heldout range registered to a source freeze

collections.evidence: Complete virtual games, identical seed deals, balanced seats, independent rules/score audit, compact failure casebook.
requires: Separate unused evaluation before model promotion

collections.task: Existing opt-in Android suites and serialized run-complete-match/run-romanian-expert scripts
collections.trigger: Explicit device acceptance under exclusive lease
collections.evidence: New measured actions, independent state/score oracle and full-display PNG inline Base64.
requires: Full-match final score for complete-game claims

collections.trigger: Explicit examination of rejected information/decision models
collections.evidence: Componente de cercetare activate explicit, pentru ipoteze și limite de model; fără activare automată în aplicație sau afirmație implicită de progres.

algorithmBuild: whist-lab-app/algorithm-build: pure JVM, cached dependencies, no SDK/device configuration
activeLearningPolicy: Explicit hashed development manifest via config/learning-corpus.json; no default traversal of raw historical or heldout games.
